# ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_bgp_state (Data Source)

Use the `ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_bgp_state` data source to fetch the BGP session state for a cloud router network service config.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_bgp_state" "example" {
  nsc_id = "nsc-123"
}

output "bgp_state" {
  value = data.ixapi_de_cix_cloud_router_bgp_state.example.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nsc_id` (String) Network service config ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as nsc_id
- `state` (String) BGP connection state (Active, Idle, Established, etc.)
